"'''Rodent'''" was a rogue [[MSE-series]] [[Mouse/Legends|mouse]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] stationed at the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] on [[Pastil/Legends|Pastil]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] noticed the odd cleaning habits of "Rodent" during an inspection of the station, Rex issued a [[Code Aurek]] alert, and the droid was [[Skirmish on Pastil|hunted down]]. A [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot from Rex blew the droid into multiple pieces, whereupon the droid's [[wheel]]s rolled off independently in an attempt to escape. The first three wheels were each eliminated, before a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] destroyed the final wheel with a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] as it tried to disappear down a vent.

==Behind the scenes==
"Rodent" was created by author [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and artist [[Tom Hodges|Thomas Hodges]] for the fifth online [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'']] comic, ''[[The Clone Wars: Mouse Hunt]]''. Although the story never explicitly states that "Rodent" is a spy, the [[Star Wars comic books|comic's]] cover description reads, "Rex and Cody root out a spy in ''Mouse Hunt''!"
